notes.title: Ready your team: Knightborn Next Fest Demo Released!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings[/h3]
I'm excited to announce the release of our demo build. In this demo, you'll explore Lyrendil Island, a showcase map created specifically for the Steam Next Fest demo to give you a taste of what we've developed so far. 

Here’s what you can expect:

[list]
[*] [b]1 to 3 Players Co-op Play:[/b] Team up with friends or go solo on your adventures.
[*] [b]Quests and Dialogues:[/b] Complete quests and talk to NPC characters that will hint at the deeper narrative to come.
[*] [b]Class Variety: [/b]Choose from Warrior, Mage, Archer, or Paladin, each offering unique abilities and playstyles.
[*] [b]Leveling Up:[/b] Progress your character, trade for better equipment, gain experience, and improve your skills.
[/list]

[b]Play the demo, and join the conversation![/b]

notes.title: Playtest live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831038/4adad5b6cefbac6686914e113de7a40c6b7aa9da.png[/img]

[b]Let the adventure begin![/b]

The time has come to experience the Knightborn journey! I'm excited to announce the release of the first playable build to a select group of 141 testers.

The test build introduces an island map that is available to play co-op and core features like quests, inventory management, map and character progression.

This initial phase of the playtest focuses on achieving balance within the core gameplay. While there's still a vast realm to explore, your experiences are invaluable. 

I'm eager to hear your feedback on the current build.

[b]Join the Community![/b]

Whether a tester or not, let's connect and discuss the future of Knightborn. You can open a discussion on Steam or join the Discord server, come say hi! 

Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/6MMee9UKCg]https://discord.gg/6MMee9UKCg[/url]

notes.title: New map for the demo, more skills, better camera controls - Knightborn Devlog 4
notes.content:
Big news on the demo map!

I started making a new map tailored to experience the core loop of Knightborn. This haunted island map once knew peace, but now terror reigns under the grip of evil powers and creatures. Gear up your team because co-op is ready to conquer the demo map with your friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831038/13465df353ee916de28542ec446e4dfe952360d3.png[/img]

Next week, I'll refine the map's shape, terrain, and enemy spawns. 

Let's dive into the new features!

[previewyoutube=tHVBqZsyoo4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Enemy combat aggression and retreat:[/b]
[list]
[*]     Enemies dynamically choose targets based on their environment and what you do.
[*]     The most damaging player attracts their aggro, keeping combat strategic.
[*]     Each enemy type follows a retreat timer, so they chase for a while then return to their post.
[/list]

[b]New ability: Stun:[/b]
[list]
[*]     Stun your enemies, disabling their movement and actions for a limited time.
[*]     Interrupt enemy attacks or create openings for strategic plays.
[*]     I'll implement priest aggro for healing later demo release.
[/list]

[b]Improved camera controls:[/b]
[list]
[*]     Now move the camera vertically for a broader view.
[*]     I initially designed top-down gameplay, but feedback requested looking ahead.
[*]     This test lets you experience more depth in the map.
[/list]

[b]Next Week: Exploring the Demo Map[/b]

cemuka

notes.title: Knightborn Weekly Report
notes.content:
This is the first weekly report and I feel excited to share the development progress of Knightborn with the community. Here are the highlights from this week:

[list]
[*] [b]Team list[/b]
Players on the same team are displayed and can be selected as target units.

[previewyoutube=Mm5D3kAhZ1w;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] [b]Gold and XP [/b]
Killing any enemy unit will grant XP and gold rewards based on its definition. These values will be shared among the same team members in a 20-unit range.

[*] [b]Item drop from inventory[/b] 
Items can be dropped by using the pointer.

[*] [b]SFX feedback [/b]
I added initial UI interaction SFX to give some input feedback.

[*] [b]Tooltips[/b] 
Currently, tooltips only display names and look a bit boring since they only display names, but they’ll improve in the next weeks. Skills, status info, items and equipment can be inspected by hovering the pointer.

[*] [b]New skill types[/b] 
This week, I implemented ally target skills like healing a team member. Another new implementation is status skills. A max HP buff skill with duration was tested with the priest class. The next test would be a slow movement or attack speed debuff. It’s not ready yet, but further implementation would be status effects with interval values (damage over time, heal over time).

[*] [b]New enemy actors [/b]
I added some new enemy actors to the game, such as goblins, skeletons, and wolves. They have different behaviors and abilities, and they will pose a challenge to the players.

[*] [b]Bonus: Minimap implementation [/b]
It was not on my list, but with some quick improvisation, I managed to add a second low-cost camera rig to render the map over the player unit top. This is a simple standard orthographic camera, but it displays extra information like enemies, team members, or NPCs for now.

[*] [b]Next week: Some level design[/b] 
I plan to work on some level design for the game, such as creating different environments, obstacles, and objectives. I want to make the game world more immersive and diverse.

[/list] 

Got feedback or ideas? I’d love to hear and discuss them, join and say hi
[url=]https://discord.gg/6MMee9UKCg[/url]

cemuka

notes.title: Knightborn Steam Page and Development
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Steam community![/h2]

I'm excited to make my first post and share the news that Knightborn Steam store page has been approved this week! As we embark on this incredible journey, I wanted to give you a sneak peek into what I've been working on and my vision for the game.

🎮 [b]Game Overview:[/b]
Knightborn follows the traditional RPG format, complete with standard controls and character stat structures commonly seen in games like MOBAs and MMORPGs. However, it's a casual and streamlined gaming experience without compromising the depth of the adventure.

[previewyoutube=JTE8neHNHEM;full][/previewyoutube]

🔨 [b]Early Progress:[/b]
Core gameplay loop is familiar: battle NPC enemies, earn experience points, loot valuable items, and enhance your equipment. I believe in the importance of a familiar yet engaging experience for players.

🌟 [b]Playable Classes:[/b]
I plan to develop four distinct playable character classes: warrior, mage, archer, and priest. Each class brings a unique playstyle to the table, ensuring a diverse and exciting gaming experience.

🗺️ [b]Open Map and Co-op Gameplay:[/b]
To enhance the gaming experience, I plan to launch early access with an open map that can be explored solo or in co-op mode. Engage with the world, loot and level up together!

⚔️ [b]PvP Potential:[/b]
While PvP gameplay is in my sight, I recognize the need for extensive testing to ensure a balanced and enjoyable experience. Stay tuned for updates on this exciting feature!

🌐 [b]Online Gaming:[/b]
Knightborn is built on the Mirror and Steam network, providing you with the opportunity to dive into the action online through Steam.

🚀 [b]Wishlist and Support:[/b]
To be a part of this thrilling adventure from the beginning, check out the Steam page! Your wishlist additions and support mean the world to me as I continue crafting Knightborn.

Thank you for joining me on this epic quest. I can't wait to share more updates with you as Knightborn evolves!
